facts.text: Environments tab provides overview and management of production and sandbox environments for the tenant.
Business Central environment can link to Power Platform environment of the same type, inheriting selected settings from Power Platform.
Cannot simultaneously link multiple Business Central environments to single Power Platform environment or vice versa.
Cannot delete Business Central environment if linked to Power Platform environment.
Copy and Restore operations create target environment not linked to Power Platform as part of operation.
Operations log retained for 180 days, then deleted; environment deletion operations retained for 180 days even after permanent deletion.
Select Environments, then select New on action ribbon to create environment.
Enter environment name, select Production or Sandbox type, specify country, and select application version.
